description: This file implements a LagoLogger class used for logging success events to the Lago platform. It manages environment validation, constructs event data with usage and user info, and supports both synchronous and asynchronous logging. It leverages external HTTP handling and logging modules, and defines internal methods for processing and sending log data.

classes.name: LagoLogger
classes.description: A logger class for logging success events to Lago, handling environment validation, constructing event data, and sending logs asynchronously or synchronously.

methods.name: get_utc_datetime()

methods.description: Initializes the LagoLogger instance, validates environment variables, and sets up HTTP clients.

methods.name: LagoLogger.validate_environment
methods.description: Checks for the presence of required environment variables for the Lago API.

methods.name: LagoLogger._common_logic
methods.description: Constructs the event data payload to log, including usage metrics and user identification, based on response objects and environment variables.

methods.name: LagoLogger.log_success_event
methods.description: Sends a success event to Lago synchronously via HTTP POST, with error handling.

methods.name: LagoLogger.async_log_success_event
methods.description: Sends a success event to Lago asynchronously, handling async HTTP calls and errors.
